scope: Prospective single scalar_legacy fresh fixed pilot; no current execution authorization
required_before_finalization: CE v2 supervisor is terminal; outputs and all32 requests preserved.
Independent CE v2 engineering postflight explicitly permits consideration of remaining VAE controls after numerical and scale assessment; author report alone is insufficient.
Root creates a NEW final single-arm plan binding the actual CE independent review path and SHA; do not edit this draft into a receipt.
Independent reviewer signs a NEW receipt for that final plan and the unchanged supervise.py hash.
Before launch root verifies no active AMP model and obtains the existing process lock; only one model job may run.
Each later arm remains separate and requires prior active arm to finish; no batch launch or automatic retry.
frozen_scientific_contract: Use exactly frozen formal_configs_v2 and vae_pipeline_formal_v2.py; no warm start, fitting extra scalers, architecture/loss/KL/schedule/seed changes or budget increase.
All32 terminal-only requests retained; no clipping, resampling, replacement or quality-based stopping/selection.
CE/MSE pair shares capacity/initialization/batch and forward RNG; scalar is whole-pipeline legacy comparator only.
No test37 access; dev monitors are descriptive only; no checkpoint selection.
Keep prior engineering costs and failures visible; actual compute frontier is not equal-compute evidence.
failure_policy: No model-phase retry; retain failed and not-executed slots. Next arm requires fresh independent assessment.
anti_accidental_launch: No jobs/output_root keys and no receipt: this document is intentionally not a supervise.py plan.
